title: Mythical Void — The Signal Log
description: See what is newly live in Mythical Void: game stories, useful resources and honest release notes linked to the playable browser game.

items.title: Twelve creatures now have a place in the story
items.content_text:
A new Project Beacon field guide connects twelve verified game-renderer creatures to the six living realms, with their real traits and new official stories kept clearly separate.

• Each realm now has two field sightings tied to a lesson already present in the game: listen, repair, keep routes open, protect warnings, use signals carefully and choose what should remain undisclosed.
• Every creature image is an exact export from the running renderer, and every trait comes from its checked genetics and DNA profile rather than new marketing invention.
• The names and short stories are official universe material, but they do not claim these twelve creatures or events are already playable quests. The current game and the wider field guide remain plainly labelled.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/creature-field-guide/

Media note: Branded proof layout, not a playable game scene. Every creature is an exact export from the running game renderer. The field-guide stories are official universe material, not claims that these events are already playable quests.
items.summary: A new Project Beacon field guide connects twelve verified game-renderer creatures to the six living realms, with their real traits and new official stories kept clearly separate.

items.title: Twelve real hatches show the engine’s range
items.content_text:
A new source-bound gallery shows twelve creatures made by the running Mythical Void genetics, DNA and pixel-rendering system—not concept art.

• The engine was run 1,000 times with deliberately balanced rarity groups, then twelve results were selected for visible breadth across all seven current species and all five rarity levels.
• The set covers all eleven genetics body families, nine head forms, six environmental auras and five personalities. Each card uses the exact sprite exported by the game renderer.
• This is a range showcase, not a probability sample, a normal hatch-odds claim or a promise of endless mathematical uniqueness. The source profiles, image fingerprints and renderer build are open for checking.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/creature-genetics/#meet-the-twelve

Media note: Branded proof layout, not a playable game scene. Every creature is an exact game-renderer export; the set was deliberately selected to show range and does not represent normal hatch odds.
items.summary: A new source-bound gallery shows twelve creatures made by the running Mythical Void genetics, DNA and pixel-rendering system—not concept art.

items.title: The real creature now takes centre stage
items.content_text:
The first hatch now gives the generated pixel creature room to be seen before the player chooses a name, and the real result is available as checked gameplay proof.

• The running genetics engine creates the creature shown in the new screenshot; no marketing illustration, replacement creature or private player state is used.
• The creature is more than twice its previous display size, the field reading no longer overlaps and old egg instructions disappear when the hatch is complete.
• The moment gives the player one clear next step. The screenshot proves one genuine hatch, not every possible creature form or an absolute uniqueness claim.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/#real-creature-hatch

Media note: Captured from the real browser game using an invented Mythical Void test state; not marketing art. It shows one genetics result and no player identity or private save.
items.summary: The first hatch now gives the generated pixel creature room to be seen before the player chooses a name, and the real result is available as checked gameplay proof.

items.title: The creator kit is now one download
items.content_text:
Adults, press and creators can now collect the checked Mythical Void gameplay videos, posters, captions, emblem and facts in one clearly labelled package.

• The package contains vertical, square and wide videos built around the same complete real gameplay frame, with matching posters and the media disclosure kept beside them.
• A checked caption pack, official emblem, fact sheet and file-by-file package record remove the need to hunt through the website or guess which version is current.
• A release checklist keeps official posting, spending, replies and child contact closed until an official channel, safeguarding cover and Kevin approval exist. No external post or message has been sent.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/#creator-download-kit

Media note: Poster from a branded social edit containing the complete real gameplay frame. The surrounding words and layout are not gameplay. No player identity or private save is shown.
items.summary: Adults, press and creators can now collect the checked Mythical Void gameplay videos, posters, captions, emblem and facts in one clearly labelled package.

items.title: Real gameplay now fits every screen
items.content_text:
One checked Mythical Void gameplay recording is now available as vertical, square and wide branded video, ready for adults, press and creators to review without changing what the game really shows.

• Every version preserves the complete moving phone-game frame and adds branding only around it; no generated motion, replacement scenery, replacement interface or replacement audio is used.
• The silent 19.58-second videos come in 1080 by 1920, 1080 by 1080 and 1920 by 1080 formats, with downloadable posters and an exact build record.
• Three source-bound caption drafts use the clean Playable Now link, make no absolute uniqueness claim and remain unposted until an official channel and Kevin approval exist.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/#real-gameplay-social-video

Media note: Poster from a branded social edit containing the complete real gameplay frame. The surrounding words and layout are not gameplay. No player identity or private save is shown.
items.summary: One checked Mythical Void gameplay recording is now available as vertical, square and wide branded video, ready for adults, press and creators to review without changing what the game really shows.

items.title: See the real game before you play
items.content_text:
A new Mythical Void page gives unfamiliar players one clear view of the real browser game, what they do in it and why the project is different before asking them to play.

• The page leads with a 19.58-second recording made directly from the running Mythical Forest level, with no generated frames or replacement scenery.
• It explains the crash, creature, six realms, restoration, Sanctuary building and Project Beacon choice in plain language, with four real game screens as proof.
• Every Play link goes directly to the free browser game without an account, download, email signup or tracking parameter.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/playable-now/

Media note: Poster captured from the real browser game using an invented test state; no generated frames, player identity or personal save information are shown.
items.summary: A new Mythical Void page gives unfamiliar players one clear view of the real browser game, what they do in it and why the project is different before asking them to play.

items.title: The Signal Log can now travel
items.content_text:
The checked Mythical Void release log is now available as an RSS feed for people and a JSON feed for future studio tools—without requiring an account or email signup.

• Both feeds are built from the same checked source as the public Signal Log, so titles, links and media notes cannot quietly drift apart.
• Every item keeps a clean mythicalvoid.com destination, its artwork or gameplay disclosure and no tracking parameters.
• Following the feed happens in the reader a person chooses; Mythical Void does not collect an email address, account or recipient.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/updates/feed.xml

Media note: Branded sharing artwork built around a real gameplay capture; the complete layout is not a raw screenshot and no player information is shown.
items.summary: The checked Mythical Void release log is now available as an RSS feed for people and a JSON feed for future studio tools—without requiring an account or email signup.

items.title: The father-and-son story is ready to share
items.content_text:
Adults, press and creators can now share wide or square artwork explaining how an Irish father-and-son experiment with imagination and generative AI tools became a playable browser game.

• Both layouts use the clean mythicalvoid.com/studio address with no tracking code.
• The background is labelled as AI-generated marketing artwork, while the framed first-contact screen is real gameplay.
• No photograph, name or identifying detail of the child is used.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/#father-son-story-social-assets

Media note: Founder-story sharing artwork, not a raw screenshot. The background is AI-generated marketing artwork, not gameplay; the framed screen is real gameplay using a company-controlled test state. No player information, photograph, name or identifying detail of the child is shown.
items.summary: Adults, press and creators can now share wide or square artwork explaining how an Irish father-and-son experiment with imagination and generative AI tools became a playable browser game.

items.title: Shared links now carry the right picture
items.content_text:
The Project Beacon story and other important Mythical Void pages now give social apps a clearer image, description and accessible image text when someone shares a link.

• The Project Beacon story now uses its purpose-built wide sharing artwork instead of a generic or easily cropped image.
• Seven public pages carry checked image sizes and matching alternative text for large link previews.
• Every preview keeps its clean mythicalvoid.com destination and the artwork-versus-gameplay boundary.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/story/

items.title: Share the game from the first screen
items.content_text:
A new Share the game button now sits beside Play on the Mythical Void homepage, making it easier for someone who enjoys the idea to pass it on.

• On supported phones and computers, the button opens the device's normal sharing choices.
• Where device sharing is unavailable, it copies the clean mythicalvoid.com address instead.
• The shared address contains no tracking code, and the Mythical Void control does not collect a recipient or contact details.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/

Media note: AI-generated marketing illustration inspired by the creature system; not gameplay.

items.title: A new way to share the game
items.content_text:
Adults can now download a one-page Mythical Void card, print it or send it, and use its QR code to open the free browser game.

• The QR code goes straight to mythicalvoid.com with no tracking code attached.
• The card includes one real Project Beacon game screen.
• The large creature-universe image is clearly labelled as generated artwork, not gameplay.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/resources/mythical-void-play-share-card.pdf

items.title: The Project Beacon story is live
items.content_text:
A new spoiler-light story page now explains the crash of Wanderer-77, first contact, six living realms and the choice waiting at the heart of Project Beacon.

• Six realm images come from the real running game.
• The page explains why the guardians are restored rather than destroyed.
• The ending remains for players to discover themselves.

See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/story/
